title: Design: a taken category name shows red under the title
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, named for example Wheel Seals.
  • Have a new category for this test, category B.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category B's row.
  3. Click the title.
  4. Type category A's name in small letters.
  5. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 2:

  • Category B's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The title becomes an outlined box.

Step 4:

  • The typed name shows in the box.

Step 5:

  • Red text right under the title box reads "A category called", the typed name, "already exists".
  • The box is outlined in red, as in picture 8.4.
